verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own developer page says users can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow' and connect mail to 5000+ apps via Zapier, which implies non-interactive programmatic operation. Its server-side automation rules also handle mail without a UI. However, there is no documentation of API authentication for unattended use, CLI tooling, or CI usage, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and machine-readable docs all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API reference/auth (e.g. API keys/tokens for non-interactive use), CLI or SDK for scripted/CI runs, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
